O. I. B. HEADQUARTERS
FILE No. 69/136
DATE 28. 9. 30

Translation of an anonymous letter addressed
to the Commissioner of Police:

Undated.

Sir,

C.D.C. Chia Sze Ming (明世解) attached
to the Hongkew Police Station is in conspiracy with
wicked merchants in Hongkew district and has a bad
reputation. He is in the habit of oppressing people
under the cover of his official duties.

Several houses have newly been constructed
(1) on Dixwell Road near the Seward Road Bridge. C.D.C.
Chia demanded from the contractor a sum of $80.00 as
necessary expenses to safeguard any material for the
construction of the houses from being stolen. Eventually
a sum of $40.00 was paid to Chia.

There are also detective "seconds" meeting
daily at the Hsin Ngauh Hsin Liao (棧昇鶴新) tea-
shop, Nos. 1101 & 1102 Hanbury Road, near the Hanbury
(2) Road Bridge. These detective "seconds" are in the
practice of committing acts of extortion. Among these
"seconds" one bearing the name of Siao Suh Tse (子失小)
is the most fierce.

You are requested to cause investigations made
into this case.

Well known to C.I.C. & I.H.
Not Known to te shop
pro prietor or shopkeeper
in the vicinity

JWHen
Mr G.S.O. C Mi
Mrs Sea Eni

a similar letter was
Received by me previously.
(1) I have personally investigated & find
nothing in the Reports. The Detachts
on these buildings deny any knowledge
of such. These Premises are Run as a teashop
& frequented by nightsoil porters & coolies
Enquire here from as to the truth & the statement all cases
warned & laid info

27 MAY 1930

情报局总部
档案编号 69/136
日期 1930年9月28日

致警务处处长的匿名信译文：

无日期。

先生：

附属于虹口捕房的华籍巡捕谢世明（Chia Sze Ming，音译）与虹口区的不法商人勾结，声名狼藉。他惯于借职务之便欺压百姓。

在靠近西华德路（Seward Road）桥梁的狄思威路（Dixwell Road）上，新建了数处房屋。(1) 华籍巡捕谢向承包商索要80.00元，声称是保护建房材料免遭盗窃的必要费用。最终，谢收受了40.00元。

此外，还有一些侦探“副手”每日在汉璧礼路（Hanbury Road）靠近汉璧礼路桥的1101及1102号“新鹤升栈”（Hsin Ngauh Hsin Liao，音译）茶馆聚会。(2) 这些侦探“副手”惯于实施敲诈勒索。在这些“副手”中，一名叫萧苏子（Siao Suh Tse，音译）的人最为凶狠。

恳请阁下对此案进行调查。

首席督察长及内务主管已知悉
附近茶馆店主或商户不知晓

JWHen
G.S.O. C Mi 先生
Sea Eni 夫人

我此前曾收到过一封类似的信件。
(1) 我已亲自调查，但在报告中未发现任何相关内容。负责这些建筑物的警队人员否认知情。这些场所作为茶馆经营，常有清粪夫和苦力光顾。在此查询真相及陈述所有案件，已发出警告并提交情报

1930年5月27日
